items.title: Rockets End the Warriors' Eight-Game Winning Streak
items.titleZh: 火箭擊敗勇士 終結對手八連勝
items.teaser: 柯瑞第一節就因傷退場，勇士隊的八連勝在休士頓畫下句點！火箭第四節連拿 8 分拉開差距，以 115 比 108 獲勝。
paras: The Houston Rockets beat the Golden State Warriors 115-108 on Wednesday night in Houston, ending Golden State's eight-game winning streak. It was the Warriors' longest winning streak since 2022. Kevin Durant led Houston with 20 points, while Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson each added 19.
休士頓火箭週三晚上在主場以 115 比 108 擊敗金州勇士，終結了勇士的八連勝。這是勇士自 2022 年以來最長的一波連勝。杜蘭特（Kevin Durant）攻下 20 分領軍火箭，申京（Alperen Sengun）和湯普森（Amen Thompson）也各拿 19 分。

Golden State lost Stephen Curry early. He scored three points and left in the first quarter with soreness in his right abdomen, and he did not return. Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg led the Warriors with 25 points and 10 rebounds, and Brandin Podziemski scored 22.
勇士很早就失去了柯瑞（Stephen Curry）。他只拿 3 分，第一節就因右腹部痠痛退場，之後沒有再回到場上。新秀倫德柏格（Yaxel Lendeborg）以 25 分、10 個籃板領軍勇士，波傑姆斯基（Brandin Podziemski）也拿下 22 分。

Houston led by nine early in the fourth quarter, but the Warriors cut the lead to 88-85. The Rockets then scored the next eight points, and back-to-back 3-pointers by Reed Sheppard and Fred VanVleet later made it 102-91. Earlier, Houston's Marcus Smart was ejected late in the third quarter for punching Charles Bassey.
火箭在第四節初領先 9 分，但勇士把差距縮小到 88 比 85。火箭接著連得 8 分，之後薛帕德（Reed Sheppard）和范弗利特（Fred VanVleet）連續投進三分球，把比分拉開到 102 比 91。在這之前，火箭的斯馬特（Marcus Smart）在第三節末段因出拳打到巴西（Charles Bassey）而被驅逐出場。
words: 複數 rookies｜a rookie season 新秀球季
adj. sore 痠痛的｜muscle soreness 肌肉痠痛
cuts · cut · cut · cutting｜cut the lead to 88-85 把領先縮小到 88 比 85
ejects · ejected · ejecting｜n. ejection｜be ejected 被驅逐出場
punches · punched · punching｜n. punch 一拳

analysis.zh: 休士頓火箭週三晚上在主場以 115 比 108 擊敗金州勇士，終結了勇士的八連勝。
parts: 動詞（過去式，與原形同形）
ending Golden State's eight-game winning streak.
analysis.note: 句尾的 ending… 是分詞構句，表示前面那件事「造成的結果」，等於 and it ended…。beat 的三態是 beat · beat · beaten，過去式和原形一樣。eight-game 是複合形容詞，game 要用單數。

analysis.zh: 杜蘭特攻下 20 分領軍火箭，申京和湯普森也各拿 19 分。
parts: while Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson each added 19.
analysis.note: while 在這裡不是「當…的時候」，而是用來並列對照兩件事（「而…」）。each 放在動詞前面，表示「兩人各自」都拿了 19 分；19 後面省略了 points，因為前面已經出現過。

opts: He had soreness in his right abdomen.
He was resting for the next game.
quiz.ex: 第二段：left in the first quarter with soreness in his right abdomen。被驅逐出場的是火箭的斯馬特。

quiz.q: Who led the Warriors in scoring?
quiz.ex: 第二段：Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg led the Warriors with 25 points。波傑姆斯基 22 分；杜蘭特是火箭的球員。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The Warriors had their longest winning streak since 2022.
The Warriors led by nine in the fourth quarter.
Marcus Smart was ejected in the fourth quarter.
The game was played in San Francisco.
quiz.ex: 第一段：It was the Warriors' longest winning streak since 2022。第四節初領先 9 分的是火箭；斯馬特是第三節末段被驅逐；比賽在休士頓。

items.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Steps In for Now
items.titleZh: 黃仁勳辭去輝達執行長 財務長暫代
items.teaser: AI 晶片巨頭輝達宣布，黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長和董事職務，立即生效。由財務長克雷斯暫代執行長，董事會也首度設立董事長。
paras: Nvidia, a chip company valued at more than $4 trillion, announced on Thursday that Jensen Huang had resigned as president, chief executive and board member, effective immediately. The board did not give a reason in its announcement. His resignation followed several media reports about his personal relationships.
市值超過 4 兆美元的晶片公司輝達週四宣布，黃仁勳已辭去總裁、執行長和董事職務，立即生效。董事會在聲明中沒有說明原因。他的辭職是在多篇關於他個人感情關係的媒體報導之後發生的。

Chief financial officer Colette Kress, who joined Nvidia in 2013, will serve as interim CEO while also keeping her finance job. Harvey Jones, a former CEO of Synopsys, became the company's first-ever board chair. Kress said she was committed to building on the foundation that Huang had created over the last 33 years.
2013 年加入輝達的財務長克雷斯（Colette Kress）將擔任代理執行長，同時繼續兼任財務長。曾任新思科技（Synopsys）執行長的瓊斯（Harvey Jones）則成為公司史上第一位董事長。克雷斯表示，她會在黃仁勳過去 33 年打下的基礎上繼續前進。

Jones said the board had full confidence in Kress and expected operations, customer commitments and product plans to continue without interruption. The board will look for a permanent CEO and will consider both internal and external candidates. Nvidia is scheduled to report its quarterly results on November 17.
瓊斯說，董事會對克雷斯有十足的信心，並預期公司營運、對客戶的承諾和產品規劃都會持續進行、不受影響。董事會將尋找正式的執行長，公司內部和外部的人選都會考慮。輝達預定在 11 月 17 日公布季度財報。
words: resigns · resigned · resigning｜n. resignation 辭職｜resign as CEO 辭去執行長
interim CEO 代理執行長｜in the interim 在這段期間
複數 interruptions｜v. interrupt｜without interruption 不中斷地
adv. permanently｜反義 temporary 暫時的
複數 candidates｜internal candidates 內部人選

analysis.zh: 2013 年加入輝達的財務長克雷斯將擔任代理執行長，同時繼續兼任財務長。
parts: while also keeping her finance job.
analysis.note: 逗號夾住的 who 子句補充說明主詞是誰。serve as… 表示「擔任…」。while keeping… 是 while she also keeps… 的省略：主詞相同時，連接詞後面可以直接接 V-ing，表示「同時」。

analysis.zh: 瓊斯說，董事會對克雷斯有十足的信心，並預期公司營運、對客戶的承諾和產品規劃都會持續進行、不受影響。
parts: the board had full confidence in Kress
受詞（省略 that 的名詞子句）
and expected operations, customer commitments and product plans
名詞子句的第二組動詞＋受詞
analysis.note: said 後面省略了 that。間接引述時時態往前推：has→had、expects→expected。expect + 受詞 + to V 表示「預期某事會…」，三個名詞並列寫成 A, B and C。

quiz.ex: 第二段：Colette Kress… will serve as interim CEO。瓊斯是董事長，正式執行長還在找。

opts: It did not give a reason.
Huang's plan to start a new company
quiz.ex: 第一段：The board did not give a reason in its announcement。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: Kress will stop working as chief financial officer.
Harvey Jones is the company's first-ever board chair.
The board will only consider people who already work at Nvidia.
Nvidia reported its quarterly results on Thursday.
quiz.ex: 第二段：Harvey Jones… became the company's first-ever board chair。克雷斯會兼任財務長；內外部人選都會考慮；財報在 11 月 17 日公布。

items.title: Taiwan's Legislature Uses AI to Read Bills Aloud for the First Time
items.titleZh: 立法院首度用 AI 朗讀法案
items.teaser: 立法院委員會首次讓 AI 朗讀 15 個版本的法案，原本要兩個多小時，AI 加速朗讀 70 分鐘就完成。
paras: For the first time, Taiwan's Legislative Yuan used artificial intelligence on Wednesday to read proposed laws aloud. A committee let AI read 15 versions of proposed changes to the Dementia Basic Act.
立法院週三首度使用人工智慧朗讀法案。社會福利及衛生環境委員會讓 AI 朗讀了 15 個版本的《失智症基本法》修正草案。

The AI read at 1.5 times normal speed for the first 10 minutes. After lawmakers said they had no difficulty keeping up, it switched to twice the normal speed. The whole reading took 70 minutes. According to committee chair Chen Ching-hui, a Kuomintang lawmaker, legislative staff would have needed about two hours and 11 minutes.
AI 前 10 分鐘用 1.5 倍速朗讀。立委表示跟得上之後，就改成 2 倍速。整個朗讀花了 70 分鐘。根據委員會召集委員、國民黨立委陳菁徽的說法，如果由議事人員朗讀，大約需要 2 小時 11 分鐘。

Chen said the committee had tested the system with the Legislature's information technology department to make sure it was accurate. The idea came after she lost her voice in 2024 and used an AI version of her voice to question Premier Cho Jung-tai. Chen hopes the first use will pave the way for wider use of AI, and Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu has set up a task force to study possible applications.
陳菁徽說，委員會事先和立法院資訊處一起測試系統，確保內容正確。這個想法來自她 2024 年失聲時，曾用 AI 生成的自己的聲音質詢行政院長卓榮泰。陳菁徽希望這次首度使用能為更廣泛的 AI 應用鋪路；立法院長韓國瑜也已成立專案小組，研究 AI 可能的應用。
words: read aloud 朗讀｜think aloud 邊想邊說出來
複數 proposals｜v. propose 提議｜adj. proposed 被提議的
paves · paved · paving｜pave the way for… 為…鋪路
複數 task forces｜set up a task force 成立專案小組

analysis.zh: 立委表示跟得上之後，就改成 2 倍速。
parts: After lawmakers said they had no difficulty keeping up,
analysis.note: After 引導表示時間的副詞子句，放句首時後面加逗號。have difficulty (in) V-ing 表示「做某事有困難」，所以 had no difficulty keeping up＝跟得上、沒有困難。twice the normal speed 是倍數的寫法：倍數＋the＋名詞。

analysis.zh: 根據委員會召集委員、國民黨立委陳菁徽的說法，如果由議事人員朗讀，大約需要 2 小時 11 分鐘。
parts: According to committee chair Chen Ching-hui,
analysis.note: would have + p.p. 表示「與過去事實相反的推測」：實際上是 AI 唸的，如果當時改由人工唸，「本來會」需要兩個多小時。逗號夾住的 a Kuomintang lawmaker 是同位語，補充說明陳菁徽的身分。

opts: 15 versions of proposed changes to the Dementia Basic Act
quiz.ex: 第一段：let AI read 15 versions of proposed changes to the Dementia Basic Act。

quiz.ex: 第二段：The whole reading took 70 minutes。2 小時 11 分鐘是人工朗讀需要的時間。

quiz.ex: 第三段：The idea came after she lost her voice in 2024 and used an AI version of her voice…

items.title: Two Fossil Teeth Reveal a Giant Rodent from 34 Million Years Ago
items.titleZh: 兩顆牙齒化石 揭開 3400 萬年前的巨型齧齒動物
items.teaser: 在泰國礦場找到的兩顆大牙齒，竟屬於一種約 30 公斤重的古老「巨鼠」！牠的名字裡還藏著泰文的「巨人」。
paras: Scientists have identified a previously unknown giant rodent that lived about 34 million years ago in what is now southern Thailand. The species, named Yakamys sirindhornae, is known from only two teeth found at the Krabi lignite mine. The teeth are remarkably large for a rodent.
科學家辨識出一種過去不為人知的巨型齧齒動物，牠大約生活在 3400 萬年前、今天的泰國南部。這個物種被命名為 Yakamys sirindhornae，目前只靠在甲米褐煤礦場找到的兩顆牙齒認識牠。以齧齒動物來說，這兩顆牙齒大得驚人。

Using seven established methods based on tooth size, the team estimated that the animal weighed about 30 kilograms, roughly twice as heavy as other known rodents from the same period. Co-author Virginie Millien of McGill University called this "only a ballpark figure," because estimating body mass from fossils involves a lot of uncertainty.
研究團隊用七種根據牙齒大小推算的既有方法，估計這種動物重約 30 公斤，大約是同時期其他已知齧齒動物的兩倍重。共同作者、麥基爾大學的米連（Virginie Millien）說，這「只是個大概的數字」，因為從化石推估體重有很大的不確定性。

The name Yakamys combines "yak," the Thai word for giant, with "mys," the Greek word for mouse or rat. The researchers say the find suggests that Southeast Asia played an important role in the early evolution of large rodents. Today, the largest living rodent is the capybara. The study was published in Scientific Reports.
Yakamys 這個名字結合了泰文的「yak」（巨人）和希臘文的「mys」（老鼠）。研究人員表示，這項發現顯示東南亞在大型齧齒動物的早期演化中扮演了重要角色。現今體型最大的齧齒動物是水豚。這項研究發表在《科學報告》（Scientific Reports）期刊。
words: 齧齒動物（如老鼠、松鼠、水豚）
adj. remarkable 非凡的｜v. remark 評論
estimates · estimated · estimating｜n. estimate /ˈestɪmət/ 估計值｜n. estimation
複數 uncertainties｜adj. uncertain｜反義 certainty

analysis.zh: 科學家辨識出一種過去不為人知的巨型齧齒動物，牠大約生活在 3400 萬年前、今天的泰國南部。
parts: that lived about 34 million years ago
in what is now southern Thailand.
修飾（地點，含 what 名詞子句）
analysis.note: that lived… 是關係子句，說明是哪一種齧齒動物。in what is now southern Thailand 很常見：what 引導名詞子句，意思是「在現今是泰國南部的地方」，因為 3400 萬年前還沒有「泰國」。previously unknown 是副詞修飾形容詞，「先前未知的」。

analysis.zh: 研究團隊用七種根據牙齒大小推算的既有方法，估計這種動物重約 30 公斤，大約是同時期其他已知齧齒動物的兩倍重。
parts: Using seven established methods based on tooth size,
that the animal weighed about 30 kilograms,
roughly twice as heavy as other known rodents from the same period.
analysis.note: 句首 Using… 是分詞構句，主詞和主要子句相同（the team），表示「用…方法」。倍數比較的句型是：倍數＋as＋形容詞＋as，例如 twice as heavy as＝兩倍重。based on tooth size 是過去分詞片語，修飾 methods。

quiz.q: What fossils were found of Yakamys sirindhornae?
quiz.ex: 第一段：is known from only two teeth found at the Krabi lignite mine。

quiz.q: Why did Millien call the weight "only a ballpark figure"?
opts: Because the team used only one method
Because estimating body mass from fossils is very uncertain
Because the teeth were too small
Because the animal is still alive
quiz.ex: 第二段：because estimating body mass from fossils involves a lot of uncertainty。團隊其實用了七種方法。

quiz.q: What does "yak" mean in Thai?
quiz.ex: 第三段："yak," the Thai word for giant。mys 才是希臘文的「老鼠」。

items.title: Cade Cunningham Scores 52 as Pistons Win in Double Overtime
items.titleZh: 康寧漢狂砍 52 分 活塞兩度延長擊敗巫師
items.teaser: 生涯新高 52 分、11 助攻、0 失誤！康寧漢寫下 NBA 自 1977-78 球季開始統計失誤以來沒人做到的紀錄，帶領活塞在兩度延長賽後險勝巫師。
paras: Cade Cunningham scored a career-high 52 points as the Detroit Pistons beat the Washington Wizards 144-140 in double overtime on Thursday night in Washington. He also had 11 assists. According to OptaSTATS, he became the first NBA player with 50 points, 10 assists and no turnovers since turnovers were first tracked in 1977-78.
康寧漢（Cade Cunningham）攻下生涯新高 52 分，帶領底特律活塞週四晚上在華盛頓經過兩度延長賽，以 144 比 140 擊敗華盛頓巫師。他還送出 11 次助攻。根據 OptaSTATS 的統計，他是自 1977-78 球季開始記錄失誤以來，第一位單場 50 分、10 助攻且零失誤的 NBA 球員。

Trae Young hit a buzzer-beating 3-pointer to force overtime, and Washington scored the first seven points of the extra period to lead 128-121. Detroit came back, but rookie AJ Dybantsa made a midrange shot with less than a second left to force a second overtime.
楊恩（Trae Young）投進一記壓哨三分球，把比賽逼進延長賽，巫師接著在延長賽一開始連得 7 分，以 128 比 121 領先。活塞追了回來，但巫師新秀迪班薩（AJ Dybantsa）在剩不到一秒時投進中距離跳投，把比賽再逼進第二次延長。

In the second overtime, Cunningham hit a 3-pointer, and Anthony Davis fouled out soon after, giving Detroit the upper hand. Young finished with 37 points and 14 assists, while Davis and Alex Sarr each scored 30. The Pistons improved to 8-3, and the Wizards have now lost six games in a row.
第二次延長賽中，康寧漢投進一記三分球，戴維斯（Anthony Davis）不久後犯滿畢業，讓活塞取得優勢。楊恩全場拿下 37 分、14 助攻，戴維斯和薩爾（Alex Sarr）也各得 30 分。活塞戰績提升到 8 勝 3 敗，巫師則已經吞下六連敗。

（球類）失誤；營業額；人員流動率
複數 turnovers｜commit a turnover 發生失誤｜staff turnover 員工流動率
forces · forced · forcing｜n. force 力量｜force overtime 逼進延長賽
tracks · tracked · tracking｜n. track 軌道；跑道｜keep track of 記錄、掌握

analysis.zh: 康寧漢攻下生涯新高 52 分，帶領底特律活塞週四晚上在華盛頓經過兩度延長賽，以 144 比 140 擊敗華盛頓巫師。
parts: as the Detroit Pistons beat the Washington Wizards 144-140
as 引導的子句（同時發生）
analysis.note: as 在這裡表示「當…的同時；就在…之際」，把個人表現和球隊勝利連在一起。career-high 是複合形容詞，放在名詞前面表示「生涯最高的」，類似的還有 season-high（本季最高）。

analysis.zh: 第二次延長賽中，康寧漢投進一記三分球，戴維斯不久後犯滿畢業，讓活塞取得優勢。

quiz.q: What record did Cade Cunningham set, according to OptaSTATS?
opts: He was the first player to score 52 points in double overtime.
He was the first player with 50 points, 10 assists and no turnovers since 1977-78.
He scored 52 points in regulation time.
He had no assists in the game.
quiz.ex: 第一段：the first NBA player with 50 points, 10 assists and no turnovers since turnovers were first tracked in 1977-78。他還有 11 次助攻。

quiz.q: How did the game go into a second overtime?
opts: Cade Cunningham made a free throw.
AJ Dybantsa made a midrange shot with less than a second left.
quiz.ex: 第二段：rookie AJ Dybantsa made a midrange shot with less than a second left to force a second overtime。楊恩的壓哨三分是逼進第一次延長。

quiz.q: Which statement is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: The game was played in Detroit.
Davis and Sarr each scored 30 points.
The Wizards have won six games in a row.
Cunningham fouled out in the second overtime.

items.title: TSMC Says It Won't Make DRAM, but Memory Makers Still Need It
items.titleZh: 台積電否認要做 DRAM 但記憶體大廠仍少不了它
items.teaser: 台積電要跨足 3D DRAM？公司出面否認，強調專心做晶圓代工。不過從 HBM 的「底層晶片」到高通的新 AI 晶片，記憶體產業還是處處看得到台積電。
paras: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) has pushed back on rumors that it plans to make 3D DRAM, a type of memory chip. The company says it will stay focused on its foundry business, which makes chips designed by other companies.
台積電出面否認外界傳言，表示並沒有計畫生產 3D DRAM 這種記憶體晶片。台積電說會繼續專注在晶圓代工本業，也就是幫其他公司製造他們設計的晶片。

Still, TSMC plays a role in high-bandwidth memory (HBM), which stacks memory chips on top of a base die. According to TrendForce, HBM base dies are expected to use TSMC's advanced processes more and more, starting with HBM4E. SK hynix and Micron are reportedly preparing to use TSMC for custom HBM4E base dies, and Nvidia has reportedly asked memory makers to use TSMC's 3nm process for its NVHBM base dies.
不過，台積電在高頻寬記憶體（HBM）上仍有一席之地；HBM 是把記憶體晶片一層層疊在一顆「基礎晶粒」上。根據集邦科技（TrendForce），從 HBM4E 開始，HBM 的基礎晶粒預計會越來越常採用台積電的先進製程。據報導，SK 海力士和美光正準備找台積電生產客製化的 HBM4E 基礎晶粒；輝達也據報要求記憶體廠用台積電的 3 奈米製程來做 NVHBM 的基礎晶粒。

TSMC is also linked to Qualcomm's new High Bandwidth Compute (HBC) chips, which place memory directly on top of the computing chip. Qualcomm validated its first HBC chips in early November. Samsung and SK hynix are expected to handle the memory stacking, while TSMC is reportedly set to help with advanced packaging.
台積電也和高通新的「高頻寬運算」（HBC）晶片有關，這種晶片把記憶體直接疊在運算晶片上方。高通在 11 月初完成首批 HBC 晶片的驗證。三星和 SK 海力士預計負責記憶體堆疊，台積電則據報將協助先進封裝。

items.title: Taiwan's Legislature Extends Maternity Leave to 14 Weeks
items.titleZh: 立法院三讀 產假延長為 14 週
items.teaser: 產假從 8 週變 14 週、陪產假從 7 天變 14 天！立法院週五三讀修法，但行政院原本的版本是 12 週，勞動部長和藍委對「產檢假能不能合併算」看法不同。
paras: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passed an amendment to the Gender Equality in Employment Act on Friday, extending maternity leave from eight weeks to 14 weeks. Paternity leave will also double from seven days to 14 days.
立法院週五三讀通過《性別平等工作法》修正案，把產假從 8 週延長為 14 週。陪產假也將從 7 天加倍為 14 天。

Before the vote, Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu held cross-party talks on the bill. The Cabinet's version would have extended maternity leave to 12 weeks, plus 10 working days of prenatal checkup leave. The opposition Kuomintang (KMT) and Taiwan People's Party (TPP) had proposed 14 weeks of maternity leave.
表決前，立法院長韓國瑜召集了朝野協商。行政院的版本是把產假延長為 12 週，另外再給 10 個工作天的產檢假。在野的國民黨和民眾黨則提案把產假延長為 14 週。

Minister of Labor Hung Sun-han defended the Cabinet's plan, saying that 12 weeks of maternity leave plus 10 days of checkup leave would add up to 14 weeks in total. KMT legislator Chen Ching-hui disagreed, saying the two kinds of leave should not be combined because some women do not start their leave until the 36th week of pregnancy. The changes are expected to take effect on Jan. 1, 2027.
勞動部長洪申翰為行政院版本辯護，表示 12 週產假加上 10 天產檢假，合計就有 14 週。國民黨立委陳菁徽則不同意，認為這兩種假不應該合併計算，因為有些女性要到懷孕第 36 週才開始請假。新制預計在 2027 年 1 月 1 日上路。

items.title: A Young Dinosaur's Skull Reveals a New Species in South Africa
items.titleZh: 南非幼年恐龍頭骨 揭開 2.2 億年前新物種
items.teaser: 一顆 21.3 公分、幾乎完整的頭骨，讓科學家認出一種 2.2 億年前的新恐龍！牠還只是兩三歲的「小朋友」，體型卻已經是同齡親戚的四倍多。
paras: Scientists have described a new species of early dinosaur from South Africa called Nyana rooiwalensis. It lived about 220 million years ago, in the Late Triassic period, and belonged to the sauropodomorphs, the group that later included giant long-necked dinosaurs such as Brontosaurus.
科學家發表了一種來自南非的早期恐龍新物種，名叫 Nyana rooiwalensis。牠生活在大約 2 億 2 千萬年前的三疊紀晚期，屬於蜥腳形類恐龍，這個類群後來也包括雷龍這類巨大的長頸恐龍。

The fossil includes a well-preserved, nearly complete skull, which is 21.3 centimeters long, and several other bones. It is the first almost complete dinosaur skull from South Africa's Late Triassic. The researchers scanned the skull with powerful X-rays and cut thin slices from the leg bones to study how the animal grew.
這件化石包括一個保存良好、幾乎完整的頭骨，長 21.3 公分，還有其他幾塊骨頭。這是南非三疊紀晚期第一個幾乎完整的恐龍頭骨。研究人員用強力 X 光掃描頭骨，並從腿骨切下薄片，研究這隻動物是怎麼長大的。

Growth rings showed that the animal was a juvenile, at least in its third year of life. Even so, it was more than four times the size of young dinosaurs of a similar age from related species. The team, led by Atashni Moopen of the University of the Witwatersrand, says adults may have weighed several tons.
骨頭的生長紋顯示，這隻恐龍還是幼年個體，至少已經活到第三年。即使如此，牠的體型已經是相近物種同齡幼龍的四倍以上。由金山大學（University of the Witwatersrand）的 Atashni Moopen 帶領的研究團隊表示，成年個體可能重達好幾噸。

items.title: Giannis Scores 34 as Heat Block 14 Shots and Beat Pistons
items.titleZh: 字母哥 34 分、熱火 14 次阻攻 擊敗活塞拿下四連勝
items.teaser: 開季 0 勝 4 敗的熱火，13 場後戰績已經翻正！字母哥 34 分 14 籃板，湯普森傷癒歸隊投進 6 記三分，熱火全隊 14 次阻攻只差隊史紀錄 1 次。
paras: Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 34 points, grabbed 14 rebounds and added eight assists as the Miami Heat beat the Detroit Pistons 137-117 on Saturday night. It was Miami's fourth straight win. Antetokounmpo scored 71 points in two days, after putting up 37 in a win over Cleveland on Friday.
字母哥安特托昆波（Giannis Antetokounmpo）週六晚上攻下 34 分、14 籃板，還有 8 次助攻，帶領邁阿密熱火以 137 比 117 擊敗底特律活塞。這是熱火的四連勝。字母哥兩天內合計拿下 71 分，週五對克里夫蘭騎士的勝仗中他就已經攻下 37 分。

Klay Thompson returned from a sprained ankle and scored 26 points, including six 3-pointers. Bam Adebayo added 20 points. Nine Heat players blocked at least one shot, and the team finished with 14 blocks, just one short of the franchise record. For Detroit, Cade Cunningham scored 33 points with eight assists, and Kevin Huerter had 20.
湯普森（Klay Thompson）從腳踝扭傷中復出，攻下 26 分，其中包括 6 記三分球。阿德巴約（Bam Adebayo）也貢獻 20 分。熱火有 9 名球員至少送出一次阻攻，全隊共 14 次阻攻，只差隊史紀錄一次。活塞方面，康寧漢（Cade Cunningham）拿下 33 分、8 助攻，赫爾特（Kevin Huerter）得 20 分。

Miami lost its first four games this season but has now won seven of its last nine to improve to 7-6. According to the report, the Heat are only the fourth team in the last 25 seasons to start 0-4 and still have a winning record after 13 games. Detroit fell to 8-4.

items.title: Judge Lets DRAM Price-Fixing Lawsuit Against Chipmakers Move Forward
items.titleZh: 法官拒絕駁回 三大記憶體廠須面對 DRAM 聯合漲價訴訟
items.teaser: 記憶體價格 18 個月漲了將近 7 倍，是 AI 需求造成，還是三大廠串通？美國法官認為原告的說法「合理可信」，三星、SK 海力士和美光得上法院說清楚。
paras: A federal judge in California has refused to dismiss a lawsuit that accuses Samsung, SK hynix and Micron of working together to limit the supply of DRAM memory chips. The three companies took more than 91% of global DRAM revenue in the third quarter of 2025. The case was brought by 17 consumers and small businesses that bought PCs, laptops and memory kits.
美國加州一名聯邦法官拒絕駁回一起訴訟；這起訴訟指控三星、SK 海力士和美光聯手限制 DRAM 記憶體晶片的供應。這三家公司在 2025 年第三季拿下全球超過 91% 的 DRAM 營收。提告的是 17 位購買電腦、筆電和記憶體套件的消費者與小型企業。

The plaintiffs point to a 697% price rise over 18 months. They say the companies cut production, stopped making older DDR4 chips at about the same time, and refused long-term supply deals for regular DRAM while focusing on HBM for AI customers. The companies argue that they were simply reacting to falling prices and then to AI demand.
原告指出，記憶體價格在 18 個月內上漲了 697%。他們說，這幾家公司減產、幾乎同時停產較舊的 DDR4 晶片，而且拒絕簽訂一般 DRAM 的長期供貨合約，同時把重心放在供應 AI 客戶的 HBM 上。這幾家公司則主張，他們只是因應價格下跌、後來又因應 AI 需求而做出調整。

Judge Noël Wise said the conspiracy claims were plausible and described the companies' behavior as "more akin to hawks flying in formation." This does not mean that anyone has been found liable. The companies must respond by December 7, and the first case management conference is set for January 12, 2027.
法官 Noël Wise 表示，原告關於串通的指控合理可信，並形容這幾家公司的行為「更像是排成隊形飛行的老鷹」。這並不代表任何一方已被判定須負法律責任。三家公司必須在 12 月 7 日前提出答辯，第一次案件管理會議則訂在 2027 年 1 月 12 日。

items.titleZh: 新北市長選戰倒數 蘇巧慧、李四川週末各自造勢
items.teaser: 11 月 28 日地方選舉進入最後兩週，新北市長選戰由民進黨蘇巧慧對上國民黨李四川，兩人週日分別和副總統蕭美琴、市長侯友宜一起拜票。
paras: With Taiwan's local elections set for Nov. 28, the two main candidates for New Taipei mayor held campaign events on Sunday. New Taipei, a city of about 4 million people, has been governed by the Kuomintang (KMT) since 2010. Mayor Hou Yu-ih cannot run again because of term limits.
台灣地方選舉將在 11 月 28 日舉行，新北市長的兩位主要候選人週日都舉辦了競選活動。新北市約有 400 萬人口，自 2010 年起一直由國民黨執政。現任市長侯友宜因為任期限制，不能再參選。

Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) candidate Su Chiao-hui, 50, held a rally in Zhonghe and Yonghe with Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim. Su praised the area's mix of cultures, saying, "Diversity is New Taipei's strength." She promised urban renewal that also protects local history and asked voters to support the DPP's city council candidates.
民進黨候選人、50 歲的蘇巧慧和副總統蕭美琴在中和、永和舉辦造勢活動。蘇巧慧稱讚當地多元文化交融，表示「多元是新北的力量」。她承諾推動兼顧在地歷史的都市更新，並請選民支持民進黨的市議員候選人。

KMT candidate Lee Shu-chuan, 68, campaigned with Hou in Sanchong and promised to build on Hou's eight-year record. "I will certainly take up the baton," Lee said. He proposed a mayor-led committee to speed up urban renewal and pledged to start building the New Taipei Dome in Shulin within four years.
國民黨候選人、68 歲的李四川和侯友宜一起在三重拜票，承諾延續侯友宜八年的施政成果。李四川說：「我一定會接下這一棒。」他提議成立由市長主導的委員會，加快都市更新流程，並承諾四年內讓樹林的新北巨蛋動工。

items.title: Did Dinosaurs Eat Seaweed? Fossil Teeth Offer a Clue
items.titleZh: 恐龍也吃海藻？牙齒化石透露一億年前的海岸菜單
items.teaser: 科學家分析恐龍、鱷魚、烏龜和魚的牙齒化石，發現住在海邊的動物可能靠著被沖上岸的海藻「加菜」：陸地和海洋的食物網，早在一億多年前就連在一起了。
paras: Some dinosaurs living near the coast may have eaten food that came from the sea, a new study suggests. Researchers studied fossil teeth from dinosaurs, crocodiles, turtles and fish that lived more than 100 million years ago. The fossils came from sites along the Western Interior Seaway, an ancient sea, and the ancient coastline of the Gulf of Mexico.
一項新研究指出，有些住在海岸附近的恐龍，可能吃過來自海洋的食物。研究人員分析了一億多年前的恐龍、鱷魚、烏龜和魚的牙齒化石。這些化石來自古代海洋「西部內陸海道」沿岸，以及古墨西哥灣的海岸線一帶。

The team measured carbon isotopes in the tooth enamel. Animals from coastal sites always showed higher carbon values than animals from inland sites, at different ages and latitudes. The scientists believe nutrients from the ocean washed onto beaches and moved up the food chain, and seaweed was the most likely source.
研究團隊測量了牙釉質中的碳同位素。不論年代或緯度，海岸地區動物的碳數值都比內陸動物高。科學家認為，海洋的養分被沖上海灘，再沿著食物鏈往上傳遞，而海藻是最可能的來源。

One plant-eating dinosaur, Tenontosaurus, did not show this pattern, so it probably did not eat marine food. Lead author Clayton Forster, a geologist at the University of Arkansas, said the study shows the connections between land and sea ecosystems. It is the first evidence of this kind of food link in prehistoric ecosystems.
不過，草食性恐龍腱龍（Tenontosaurus）沒有出現這種模式，所以牠大概沒有吃海洋食物。第一作者、阿肯色大學地質學家福斯特（Clayton Forster）說，這項研究顯示了陸地和海洋生態系之間的連結。這是史前生態系中第一次發現這類食物連結的證據。
words: 複數 fossils｜fossil fuel 化石燃料｜v. fossilize 使變成化石
n. coast 海岸｜coastal areas 沿海地區

analysis.note: living near the coast 是現在分詞片語，等於 that lived near the coast。may have eaten 是 may have + p.p.，表示對過去的推測「可能曾經…」。新聞常把 a new study suggests 放在句尾，意思等於 A new study suggests that…。

analysis.note: believe 後面省略了 that；子句的主詞是 nutrients from the ocean，兩個動詞 washed 和 moved 並列。the most likely 是最高級，意思是「最有可能的」。

quiz.ex: 第一段：Researchers studied fossil teeth from dinosaurs, crocodiles, turtles and fish。

items.title: Luka Doncic Scores 43 as Lakers Win Eighth Straight Game
items.titleZh: 唐西奇轟 43 分 湖人擊敗太陽豪取八連勝
items.teaser: 湖人一度領先 31 分，太陽第四節狂追仍差一截！唐西奇拿下本季第 6 場 40 分以上，湖人戰績來到 12 勝 2 敗。
paras: Luka Doncic scored 43 points as the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Phoenix Suns 131-123 on Sunday. It was the Lakers' eighth win in a row, and they improved to 12-2. Doncic, the NBA's leading scorer, made five 3-pointers and 12 of his 14 free throws. It was his sixth 40-point game this season.
唐西奇（Luka Doncic）週日攻下 43 分，帶領洛杉磯湖人以 131 比 123 擊敗鳳凰城太陽。這是湖人的八連勝，戰績提升到 12 勝 2 敗。身為聯盟得分王的唐西奇投進 5 記三分球，罰球 14 罰 12 中。這是他本季第 6 場得分 40 分以上的比賽。

Doncic had 25 points by halftime, and the Lakers led 64-54 at the break. They kept attacking after halftime and led by 31 points late in the third quarter. Quentin Grimes added 22 points and made five of his six 3-point shots. The Lakers played without Austin Reaves, who has a bruised heel.
唐西奇上半場就拿下 25 分，湖人中場以 64 比 54 領先。下半場湖人持續進攻，第三節尾聲一度領先 31 分。格萊姆斯（Quentin Grimes）貢獻 22 分，三分球 6 投 5 中。湖人這場少了腳跟挫傷的里夫斯（Austin Reaves）。

Phoenix fought back in the fourth quarter behind Collin Gillespie, who scored 26 points, including 12 in the final period. His layup cut the lead to 126-121 with 1:05 left, but the Suns got no closer. Devin Booker had 17 points on 4-of-14 shooting, and Phoenix fell to 5-7.
太陽在第四節靠著吉萊斯皮（Collin Gillespie）展開反撲，他全場拿下 26 分，其中 12 分在最後一節。他的上籃在比賽剩 1 分 05 秒時把比分追到 121 比 126，但太陽沒能再更接近。布克（Devin Booker）14 投 4 中拿 17 分，太陽戰績降到 5 勝 7 敗。

items.title: Asian Chip Stocks Tumble After Nvidia CEO Exit
items.titleZh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳卸任 亞洲晶片股重挫、台股創史上第二大點數跌幅
items.teaser: 輝達宣布黃仁勳辭去執行長，週一台積電跌 5.7%、加權指數狂瀉 2,635 點，SK 海力士也跌近 8%。大家都在等輝達週二晚間公布財報。
paras: Shares of major Asian chipmakers fell sharply on Monday, November 16, as investors worried about the future of Nvidia, the world's leading AI chip designer. According to reports, Nvidia said on November 12 that Jensen Huang had resigned as CEO, and chief financial officer Colette Kress became interim chief.
亞洲主要晶片公司的股價在 11 月 16 日週一大幅下跌，因為投資人擔心 AI 晶片龍頭輝達（Nvidia）的未來。根據報導，輝達在 11 月 12 日表示黃仁勳已辭去執行長一職，由財務長克芮斯（Colette Kress）擔任代理執行長。

In Taiwan, shares of TSMC dropped about 5.7% to NT$2,215. The Taiex fell 6.03%, or 2,635 points, to 41,040.08, the second-largest point drop in the index's history. In South Korea, memory chipmaker SK Hynix lost 7.89%, while Samsung Electronics fell 4.47%.
在台灣，台積電股價下跌約 5.7%，收在新台幣 2,215 元。加權指數下跌 6.03%，也就是 2,635 點，收在 41,040.08 點，是指數史上第二大的點數跌幅。在南韓，記憶體大廠 SK 海力士下跌 7.89%，三星電子則跌 4.47%。

Investors are now waiting for Nvidia's third-quarter results, which are due on Tuesday, November 17, after the U.S. market closes. The company had earlier forecast revenue of about $108 billion. The results may show whether demand for AI chips is still strong after the change in leadership.
投資人現在正等待輝達的第三季財報，預定在 11 月 17 日週二美股收盤後公布。輝達先前預估營收約 1,080 億美元。這份財報可能會顯示，在領導階層更換之後，市場對 AI 晶片的需求是否依然強勁。

items.title: Two Sides Debate Nuclear Power Ahead of Taiwan's Referendum
items.titleZh: 核電公投前辯論 擁核與反核代表各自表述
items.teaser: 11 月 28 日的公投要問大家是否恢復核電。中選會舉辦的辯論會上，擁核的黃士修和反核的沈佩玲各提出了哪些理由？
paras: Ahead of a referendum on restoring nuclear power, a supporter and an opponent of nuclear energy debated on Monday at a livestreamed forum organized by Taiwan's Central Election Commission. The referendum will be held on November 28, together with local elections.
在恢復核電的公投之前，一位擁核人士和一位反核人士週一在中央選舉委員會舉辦、全程直播的發表會上展開辯論。這次公投將在 11 月 28 日和地方選舉一起舉行。

Pro-nuclear activist Huang Shih-hsiu urged voters to support restoring nuclear power. He said the ruling Democratic Progressive Party's goal of a nuclear-free Taiwan had made the country rely too much on natural gas and thermal power, and that the party had failed to meet its renewable energy targets.
擁核人士黃士修呼籲選民支持恢復核電。他說，執政的民進黨追求「非核家園」，使台灣過度依賴天然氣和火力發電，而且民進黨也沒有達成再生能源的目標。

Shen Pei-ling, a spokeswoman for the Taiwan Obasang Political Equality Party, agreed that nuclear power has low emissions and a stable supply. However, she said the referendum offers no clear plans for nuclear waste or for how nuclear power would return, and that local communities had not been properly consulted. Taiwan shut down its last operating reactor, at Maanshan, in May 2025.
歐巴桑聯盟發言人沈佩玲同意核電排碳低、供電穩定。不過她說，這次公投沒有提出處理核廢料、或核電要怎麼重新上路的明確計畫，而且也沒有好好徵詢地方社區的意見。台灣最後一座運轉中的反應爐——核三廠（馬鞍山），已在 2025 年 5 月停機。

items.title: Emergency Blanket Material Could Protect Future Moon Bases
items.titleZh: 急救毯的材料 有望成為月球基地的隔熱層
items.teaser: 月球溫差從零下幾百度到沸騰都有！賓州大學把急救毯用的超薄塑膠疊上幾百層，做成又耐壓又隔熱的材料，連呼吸都會把它吹飛。
paras: Engineers at the University of Pennsylvania have turned Mylar, the thin plastic used in emergency blankets, into a strong insulation material that could help people live on the Moon. Temperatures on the Moon can swing from hundreds of degrees below zero to boiling hot, so bases and spacesuits need good protection.
賓州大學的工程師把急救毯使用的薄塑膠「聚酯薄膜」（Mylar），變成一種堅固的隔熱材料，未來可能幫助人類在月球上生活。月球的溫度可以從零下幾百度變化到滾燙，所以基地和太空衣都需要良好的保護。

The team stacked hundreds of extremely thin Mylar sheets, and some were coated with a very thin layer of aluminum oxide. The layers are so light that, as first author Danielle Levin said, even breathing near them can send them flying. Yet the stacks survived being pressed at about 20 megapascals 10 times in a row.
研究團隊把數百張極薄的聚酯薄膜疊在一起，其中一些還鍍上一層非常薄的氧化鋁。這些薄膜輕到像第一作者李文（Danielle Levin）說的，連在旁邊呼吸都可能把它們吹飛。然而這些薄膜堆疊被以約 20 百萬帕的壓力連續壓了 10 次，仍然完好無損。

Senior author Igor Bargatin said the ideal material must resist both damage and heat loss, because astronauts will inevitably bump into things. The researchers say the material could be used in lunar habitats, spacesuits and rovers. Their study was published in the journal ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces.
資深作者巴加汀（Igor Bargatin）說，理想的材料必須同時能抵抗損壞和熱量流失，因為太空人難免會撞到東西。研究人員表示，這種材料可以用在月球居住艙、太空衣和探測車上。這項研究發表在期刊《ACS 應用材料與介面》。
words: v. insulate（insulates · insulated · insulating）｜heat insulation 隔熱
stacks · stacked · stacking｜n. stack 一疊；一堆｜a stack of books 一疊書
coats · coated · coating｜n. coating 塗層｜n. coat 外套
adj. inevitable 不可避免的｜n. inevitability
複數 habitats｜natural habitat 自然棲地｜lunar habitat 月球居住艙

analysis.zh: 賓州大學的工程師把急救毯使用的薄塑膠變成一種堅固的隔熱材料，未來可能幫助人類在月球上生活。
parts: 修飾主詞（哪裡的工程師）
the thin plastic used in emergency blankets,
同位語（說明 Mylar 是什麼）
turn A into B 的 B
that could help people live on the Moon.
analysis.note: turn A into B 是「把 A 變成 B」，中間的 A 很長，因為插了一個同位語。同位語裡的 used in emergency blankets 是過去分詞片語，等於 which is used in…。最後 that 引導關係子句修飾 material；help＋人＋原形動詞（help people live）。

analysis.zh: 這些薄膜輕到像第一作者李文說的，連在旁邊呼吸都可能把它們吹飛。
parts: as first author Danielle Levin said,
插入的 as 子句（正如…所說）
analysis.note: so＋形容詞＋that…表示「太…以至於…」。that 後面插入 as 子句，as 在這裡是「正如」。結果子句的主詞是動名詞片語 breathing near them；send＋受詞＋V-ing 表示「使…（猛然）做某動作」，send them flying 就是「把它們吹飛」。

quiz.q: What is Mylar usually used for?
quiz.ex: 第一段：Mylar, the thin plastic used in emergency blankets。月球太空衣是未來可能的用途。

quiz.q: How did the stacks perform in the pressure test?
opts: They survived 10 tests in a row.
quiz.ex: 第二段：the stacks survived being pressed at about 20 megapascals 10 times in a row。

quiz.q: Why must the material resist damage, according to Bargatin?
opts: It is very expensive to make.
Astronauts will inevitably bump into things.
quiz.ex: 第三段：because astronauts will inevitably bump into things。呼吸會把薄膜吹飛，是講操作實驗時的小困難，不是損壞的原因。

source.title: ScienceDaily（Penn Engineering）：The secret to building Moon bases may be hiding in emergency blankets（2026/11/15）
